evals.prompt: Implement an accessible 'Invite team member' settings dialog in HTML/CSS/JS. Use native <dialog>, labelled fields with inline validation, visible focus rings, Esc/close behaviour with focus return, and reduced-motion-aware transitions.
evals.expected_output: Native dialog with labels, aria-invalid/aria-describedby errors, focus-visible styles, focus return, prefers-reduced-motion handling.

evals.prompt: Implement a high-density invoices data table component: sortable column header buttons with aria-sort, tabular numbers right-aligned, status badges with icon + text, row actions menu, pagination, empty state, and mobile-first responsive behaviour.
evals.expected_output: Semantic table (not role=grid) with aria-sort header buttons, tabular-nums, accessible badges, pagination, empty state and responsive handling.
